package.description: A fast, portable dual-pane file manager for Windows with tabs, a built-in terminal and 57 themes

en-US.description: A fast, portable dual-pane file manager for Windows with tabs, a built-in terminal and 57 themes
en-US.longDescription: Zenith Filer is a dual-pane file manager for Windows 10 and 11. It starts in about a second and keeps every file operation off the UI thread, so it stays responsive even on corporate PCs slowed down by antivirus software. Each pane has its own tabs, and up to four terminals can follow your folders. You can build macros without code, use optional AI features (fully local with Ollama), and pick from 57 themes. Free to use with daily limits on some features; Pro is a one-time purchase.
en-US.name: Zenith Filer
